description: The plot illustrates how retrieval effectiveness (MRR@10) varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for four DPR variants (no query expansion, corpus expansion, document expansion, and asymmetric expansion). The x-axis is labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)” on a linear scale, with visible tick labels at 4, 6, and 8 (regular spacing of 2), and the plotted points extend from about S=1 on the left to about S=9 on the right. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 33.5 to 36.0 with tick labels at 33.5, 34.0, 34.5, 35.0, 35.5, and 36.0 (interval 0.5). A black solid line (“DPR w/o query”) increases gently across S, starting just above 34.0 at the left and ending around the mid–35 range near the right edge. A red solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ corpus expansion”) rises steadily, beginning around 35.1 at the leftmost point and reaching roughly 36.0 at the rightmost point, with intermediate points increasing monotonically. A green solid line with upward triangle markers (“DPR w/ document expansion”) also increases across S, starting just under 35.0 at the left and ending around 35.7–35.8 near the rightmost point. A blue solid line with star markers (“DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”) shows small fluctuations while trending upward overall, starting just under 35.0 at the left, rising to around the mid–35s by mid-range S, dipping slightly around the middle, and ending near about 35.5 at the rightmost point.
